'''2004 New Jersey Open Qualifier''' was a Star Wars CCG Open Qualifier for the [[2004 World Championship]], played on Saturday 14 August 2004 at Dark Tower Games in Denville, New Jersey. It was the last chance qualifier before the World Championship at Gen Con, with two Day 2 seats and the Players Committee's "Ultimate Package" of prizes, including the design of a virtual card.<ref name="pcf-3634">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040822082026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3634&amp Updated - Open Qualifier 8/14/04 in New Jersey], Scott Lingrell (director's report, 14 August 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 August 2004.</ref> [[Scott Lingrell]] directed it. 27 players took part, including two from Germany ([[Chris Menzel]] and Enno Haede). After six games [[Michael Dalton|Mike Dalton]] and [[Greg Shaw]] were first and second; the players chose not to play the final confrontation, and Dalton awarded Shaw the grand prize of designing a virtual card.<ref name="pcf-3634" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Dark Tower Games, Denville, New Jersey<ref name="pcf-3634" />
* '''Dates:''' 14 August 2004<ref name="pcf-3634" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]<ref name="pcf-3634" />
* '''Players:''' 27<ref name="pcf-3634" />

The report counts 15 distinct Light Side and 13 Dark Side deck types, including five Imperial Occupation (V) and five CCT decks on the Dark Side. Items were auctioned during the day for the Players Committee. A Friday "Gauntlet" event was announced and then cancelled.<ref name="pcf-3634" />
